text: 港股午间收盘，恒生指数涨0.78%，恒生科技指数涨0.87%。板块方面，数据处理和外包服务、金属包装板块涨幅靠前；可选消费经销Ⅲ、可选消费经销Ⅳ板块跌幅靠前。个股方面，白鸽在线涨14.11%，百奥赛图-B涨9.79%，再鼎医药涨8.34%，亚盛医药涨8.06%，智谱涨8.05%；怡俊集团控股跌15.5%，金川国际跌6.94%，中环新能源跌6.68%，思格新能跌4.93%，景旺电子跌4.49%。
text_en: Hong Kong stocks closed the morning session with the Hang Seng Index up 0.78% and the Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.87%. By sector, data processing and outsourcing services and metal packaging led gains; discretionary consumer distribution III and discretionary consumer distribution IV led declines. Among individual stocks, Baige Online rose 14.11%, Biocytogen-B rose 9.79%, Zai Lab rose 8.34%, Ascentage Pharma rose 8.06%, and Zhipu rose 8.05%; Yijun Group Holdings fell 15.5%, Jinchuan International fell 6.94%, Central New Energy fell 6.68%, Sigenergy fell 4.93%, and Jingwang Electronics fell 4.49%.
